technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with multiple golden crosses and price above all key moving averages, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: FANG shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 33 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 18) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; AAII bearish dominance (61%) reinforces capitulation setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 33 days present binary risk for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multiple golden crosses (EMA 9/21, 20/50) with price structure above key moving averages and extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis, AAII 61% bearish) create classic capitulation reversal setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators across all momentum indicators (Stoch, Williams %R, UO, StochRSI), weak ADX trend confirmation, unfavorable macro (inverted yield curve, VIX 312.3), NFP volatility in 2 days, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk entry into deteriorating conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows golden crosses and price above key MAs, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend confirmation severely limit swing entry probability in a macro crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (312.3), inverted yield curve signaling recession, NFP volatility in 2 days, and zero fundamental/smart money support create compounding macro headwinds that invalidate technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 20 Energy positions with existing FANG exposure; sector concentration + macro deterioration + earnings binary risk (33 days) warrant avoidance despite technical setup.
